Aufhebung des Vergabeverfahrens Der Auftraggeber kann das Vergabeverfahren nach § 63 VgV aufheben. Er behält sich insbesondere eine Aufhebung des Vergabeverfahrens vor, wenn nach Auffassung des Auftraggebers die Angebote kein wirtschaftliches Ergebnis gehabt haben. 2.16. Jede Veröffentlichung oder Weitergabe (auch auszugsweise) ist untersagt, es sei denn sie dient der Angebotserstellung. To support this mission, the Government requires a modern software solution that serves as a relational database and analysis toolset. The GUI shall be designed to allow an operator with basic TDL knowledge to achieve proficiency on core tasks in no more than three (3) standard working days. nual data entry. 3.1.3 Data and Issue Management: • 3.1.3.1 Management of TDL Differences: The software shall allow users to capture, document, and grade deviations from a standard TDL baseline directly within a platform's implementation record. This capability must allow operators to identify and prioritize interoperability issues and potential workarounds within a single system. • 3.1.3.2 Platform Issue Tracking: The software shall provide a mechanism to record and maintain a history of platform-specific issues (e.g., design, testing, operational) through their entire lifecycle. This information must be linked to the platform specification to enable automatic updates to existing analyses. • 3.1.3.3 Capabilities & Limitations Summary: The software shall be capable of generating a consolidated, high-level summary of a platform's TDL capabilities, including implemented TDLs, message baselines, equipment fits, and network capabilities (e.g., Link 22, JREAP). 3.1.4 Interoperability (IO) Evaluation: The software shall provide a robust module to conduct detailed, multi-platform IO evaluations. Answer: The security clearance process for instructors and supervisors is estimated to take approximately 4–6 weeks after completion of RAM vetting and receipt of necessary documents. Offerors should plan accordingly and allow sufficient time for the completion of security clearances before the instructors and supervisors are scheduled to commence work onsite. The estimated processing time may vary depending on the scrutiny of the submitted documentation and completion of applicable security clearance procedures. The contractor will be responsible for ensuring that all instructors obtain the required security clearances before commencing services, in accordance with the requirements of the RFQ and the resulting contract.
